title: The manual told agents every command was non-interactive, and two wait for a human
foundBy: session agent, walking README.md and INSTALL.md as a first-time reader

evidence.verified: Read against internal/cli/misc_commands.go, where agent-login passes engine.ExecIO{Interactive: true}, and against MANUAL.md's own host-route paragraph, which says `up` asks for sudo once.

details:
MANUAL.md's notes for agents opened with "Every command is non-interactive. Nothing waits on an answer, so nothing hangs unattended." That section exists so an automated caller can trust the surface.

`agent-login` runs the agent inside the sandbox with `Interactive: true` and prints "follow the prompts, then exit" (`internal/cli/misc_commands.go`). `host-route up` asks for `sudo`, as the same manual says two sections earlier. An agent that trusts the note calls either one unattended and hangs.
